   import collections

   # Remove non-alphabetic characters and convert to lowercase
   value = re.sub(r'\W+', '', value).lower()

   # Correct common spelling errors in occasion names
   corrected_value = value.replace('anniversariesary', 'anniversary') \
                      .replace('complimentarytestimonial', 'complimentary/testimonial') \
                      .replace('secular holiday', 'secular holiday') \
                      .replace('daily menu', 'daily')

   # Group similar values and return unique groups
   grouped_values = collections.defaultdict(list)
   for value in corrected_value:

   unique_groups = list(set(grouped_values.keys()))
